CrawlEngine with defaults scrapes a page identically to the free function

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineObj = try createEngine(config: nil)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.statusCode())
debugPrint(result.contentType())
debugPrint(result.metadata().title() as Any)
debugPrint(result.metadata().description() as Any)
debugPrint(result.links().count)
debugPrint(result.metadata().headings() as Any)
```
